goals: reduce fake-news false negatives through validation-selected operating modes
evaluate evidence retrieval and verification on a new external benchmark
preserve short factual source sentences and passage context
classifier_selection: Existing trained ensemble fixed; select balanced macro-F1 threshold and high-recall threshold (validation recall >=0.80, maximize precision) on original validation only. Test follow-up evaluation after thresholds frozen.
scifact_selection: Use 150 stratified claims from official train for tuning. Do not use official dev labels in selection. Freeze retrieval/NLI parameters before evaluating all 300 official dev claims. This is a new-to-project benchmark, not a private blind test and not official SciFact leaderboard metrics.
retrieval: TF-IDF plus frozen MiniLM embeddings over the full scientific abstract corpus; score up to three retrieved full abstracts with frozen NLI; no gold evidence IDs passed to retrieval
limits: English only; science benchmark does not establish general news accuracy; unknown pretrained-corpus overlap; no fabricated corrections; evidence quotes always attributed

development_extension.reason: Frozen general NLI achieved only 49.33% accuracy and 43.28% macro-F1 on the 150 tuning claims; official dev was not evaluated.
development_extension.action: Adapt DeBERTa on remaining 659 official train claims, selecting epoch using only the 150 tuning claims; compare adapted and original tuning pipelines before final official dev evaluation.
